description: Fragment (top part) of a business letter in Arabic script from Natan b. Yehoshuaʿ b. Natan, in Alexandria, to Nahray b. Nissim, in Fustat. Mentions dealings with Abū l-Ḥasan al-Kātib. Nahray is supposed to deliver the sender's father's letter to somebody and urge them to obtain the jizya receipt.
description_he: מכתב עסקי בכתב ערבי מנתן בן יהושע בן נתן באלכסנדריה אל נהריי בן נסים בפסטאט.
